notes: Mainline PC(USA), not PCA. Affiliation confirmed 2026-09-10 from the church's own About page: 'Christ Presbyterian Church is part of the Presbyterian Church (USA) and is one of twenty-nine churches within Presbytery de Cristo.' Address 6565 E. Broadway Blvd., Tucson AZ 85710 confirmed from cpctucsonaz.org/contact-us/. Steve Melde is the only pastor on the staff page (Pastor and Head of Staff); the rest of the staff are non-preaching (music, children's education, office, AV), so he is the only preaching pastor recorded. The church links a YouTube channel (@cpctucsonaz2095) from its site footer; the channel has no playlists, so sermons would have to be pulled from the uploads/videos feed and it is not confirmed that full sermons (as opposed to whole services) are posted. Note it shares the Broadway corridor with Fellowship Bible Church (6700 E Broadway); different churches, do not conflate. Coordinates are still only approximate; run tools/geocode.py.
